top_apps.description_excerpt:
Ice Pull is a reaction and timing game that puts you in the middle of an intense ice fishing challenge. A fish is hooked beneath the ice, but pulling it out is not as easy as it seems. You must carefully control the tension of the fishing line to avoid losing your catch.

Hold your finger on the screen to pull the fish upward. As the tension meter rises, watch it closely. When the gauge reaches the red zone, release immediately to prevent the line from snapping. Once the meter returns to the green zone, start pulling again.

Every fish fights back with sudden jerks, making each catch unpredictable. Releasing too often allows the fish to swim deeper, while holding for too long breaks the line. As you progress, the safe green zone becomes smaller, demanding even greater precision.

Your goal is to pull the fish out of the ice hole before the timer expires. Break the line or let the fish escape too deep, and the round is over.

◆ 招募各族店員，養成最佳夥伴
招募不同種族的夥伴，每位店員都有獨特技能加成與能力傾向。招募店員並依據能力管理，把對的人放對位置，經營效率顯著提升。養成系統包含等級、星級、屬性、技能等多條成長線，收集店員圖鑑，解鎖人物小傳，逐步擴大商業版圖，讓小店從一人經營發展到溫暖家園。輕鬆當老闆，享受休閒又療癒的養成樂趣。

◆ 傾聽顧客故事，解鎖暖心劇情
每位上門的客人都有屬於自己的回憶與秘密。透過對話與專屬任務，幫助他們找回「記憶碎片」，解鎖豐富的故事線與人物小傳。隨著好感度逐步提升，特殊顧客會成為常客，帶來更穩定的收入。經營的不只是小店，更是人與人之間的溫暖連結。在休閒之餘，體驗沉浸式的暖心劇情。

◆ 研發多樣菜譜，親手創造美味
從榛果司康、海嶼小麵到奶油杯麵，超多創意料理等你解鎖，涵蓋飲品、烘焙、甜品、輕食等豐富品類。簡單卻有挑戰的反應類小玩法「抓時機點擊」，在指針轉盤上按順序精準投入食材，順序錯誤就失敗，解壓又療癒，讓每一道菜都充滿親手製作的成就感。

◆ 自由裝潢改造，隨心打造家園
桌椅、壁紙、地毯、擺飾…所有家具都透過隨機合成獲得，每次合成都像開盲盒一樣充滿驚喜！你可以自由規劃佈置，搭配古典雅緻、簡約時尚、浪漫童話、田園鄉村等不同主題，打造獨一無二的森系小店。從室內裝潢到花園種植收集鮮花，每個角落都由你決定。

◆ 穿搭百變風格，展現個性魅力
店員不只是幫手，還能換裝搭配當季流行服飾。甜美、幹練、華麗、簡約…各種風格隨心切換。收集限定時裝，提升店鋪魅力值，吸引更多客人上門。解鎖每一位店員的人物小傳，與店員互動培養親密度，讓每一次換裝都充滿樂趣與成就感。

HOW TO PLAY Chicken Road
Chicken Road follows three simple steps that anyone can pick up in seconds:
👀 WATCH — Cards light up one by one in a specific order. Stay focused and pay close attention to every flash in the sequence.
🧠 MEMORIZE — Lock that order into your memory. The longer the sequence gets, the tougher the challenge becomes.
👆 REPEAT — Tap the cards back in the same order you saw them. Get it right, and you move on to the next round. One wrong tap and your combo is gone!
It sounds easy at first, but as the rounds progress in Chicken Road, sequences get longer and trickier. Can you keep up?

top_apps.description_excerpt:
Gnome From Hell is a chaotic stealth prank game where you lead a crew of mischievous gnomes on a mission to drive an angry grandpa insane. Sneak through the house, complete outrageous tasks, and unleash pure mayhem before you get caught!

Play as a troublemaking gnome with AI buddies and complete a set number of pranks to win. Smash objects, steal valuables, flush items down the toilet, or devour anything you find — every prank brings you closer to victory and makes grandpa furious.

But beware: grandpa is always hunting the gnomes. If he catches one of you, the punishment gets harsher each time. He might throw you outside, flush you away, or eliminate you from the mission. Lose too many teammates and your prank operation falls apart.

Watch out for traps hidden throughout the house — one wrong step and grandpa can capture a gnomes intruder instantly.

Features:

• Command a squad of chaotic gnomes

Forget about heavy parachute packs or safety ropes—this is a rapid, action-packed freefall where your sense of timing determines your ultimate high score. Watch the sky closely, find the perfect second, and see how many mystic treasures you can gather on your way down.

Choose your starting stakes before the round begins, hit the large golden play button, and watch an automated descent unfold. Your character navigates the desert sky completely on his own, making the gameplay incredibly smooth and accessible for everyone.

top_apps.description_short: She wants to play with you...
top_apps.description_excerpt:
She was left alone in this mansion… and she’s starting to get bored.
If she sees you or hears even the slightest sound, she will come after you.
Are you ready for the chase?

You wake up at midnight inside a labyrinth-like mansion.
With two floors and a basement, the only way out of this dark house is unlocking its sealed doors.

But stay quiet.
A dropped object or a small noise can reveal your location.
You can hide in closets, under beds, in bathrooms, or even inside washing machines.

Some doors require focus and courage.
Solve mini-games, progress forward, and try to escape this house.

Upgrade your abilities in the shop, choose your power-ups, and climb to the top of the leaderboard.
